capabilities: Paste clipboard as a single Canvas node
Build heading-tree nodes with arrow connections
Build list-tree nodes from bullet or numbered indentation
Split paragraphs into separate top-to-bottom nodes
Auto-detect content structure for tree paste
extras: README content is duplicated in English and Chinese; installation covers manual and BRAT methods only.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that intelligently pastes clipboard content into Canvas as nodes.
problem: Pasting structured text into a Canvas file yields one undifferentiated node instead of organized, connected nodes.
summary: Pastes clipboard content into Canvas as nodes: single node, heading tree, list tree, paragraphs, or auto-detected structure.
